purpose: Human isogenic DSP knockout EHT full author differential test for genetic cardiomyopathy, tier2. Reopened full-statistic evidence under ADR0073.

local_additions.origin: Full author edgeR table, every row preserved; no refit.

notes: Primary paper PMC11213508 verifies human DSP knockout/isogenic control EHT comparison,3 RNA libraries per arm, supporting fibroblasts. Other deposited DSP/JUP/PKP2 tables use rat NRVM and are not ingested. Author LR statistic is not a signed t statistic. All author adjusted p values and log2 fold changes preserved.
